Write one table to a temp file for .bind_spilled(), keeping only its shape in memory

Source: R/utils.R
dot-spill_piece.Rd

Skills step 01 used to hold ~340 league-season tables in memory until the bind; at 2.49M rows x 421 columns the process peaked at 13.6-14.6 GB on a 16 GB runner (panna#475). Spilling each piece as it is built keeps the loop's memory flat.

Usage

.spill_piece(dt, dir)

Arguments

dt

A data.frame / data.table.

dir

Directory for the file (created if missing).

Value

A list: path, n (rows), cols (names), types (typeof per column), classes (first class per column).
